observations: RUN-ECDLP-RECURSIVE-001 completed valid in 25.249 seconds with 87,982,080 peak RSS; all six group orders were prime and all 24 rho controls verified.

RUN-ECDLP-RECURSIVE-002 independently reconstructed 216 configurations, six curve orders, all targets, factor-base sources, recursive supports, first witnesses, operation counters, rho trials, and exact promotion decisions.
The frozen gate promoted rational_union|sign_complete|m=8 in four instances and square_map/x_interval|sign_complete|m=8 in three instances each.

Every per-instance row that passed the frozen gate had generic-maximum four-term support: 225 for B=8 or 985 for B=12; no B=10 row passed, and advice-byte ratios in passing rows lay near one rather than showing compression.
The random-x to random-scalar frontier ratios across the six instances were 0.5705, 0.6583, 0.8856, 0.9652, 1.3564, and 1.4155.
Seed 1473002 at 12 bits produced p=q=3931 and trace 1; the candidate checklist excludes anomalous curves, but generator and verifier rejected trace 0 only.
